What We Do

Appliance repair
for every room.

Refrigerators, washers, dryers, ovens and more — all major brands across the Tri-Cities. No confusing jargon, no surprise pricing.

See all services
Residential
Upfront pricing

Refrigerator Repair

Not cooling, leaking, or making odd noises? We repair all refrigerator types — French door, side-by-side, top and bottom freezer — across every major brand in the Tri-Cities.

Book this service
Residential
Upfront pricing

Washing Machine Repair

Won't drain, won't spin, or leaking water? We fix front-load and top-load washers quickly — most repairs completed on the first visit with parts on hand.

Book this service
Residential
Upfront pricing

Dryer Repair

No heat, long dry times, or a drum that won't turn? Our technicians repair both gas and electric dryers and check your vent system for safe, efficient operation.

Upfront pricing

Dishwasher Repair

Not cleaning, not draining, or leaking? We service every major dishwasher brand including built-in, portable and drawer-style models across Richland, Pasco and Kennewick.

Upfront pricing

Oven & Range Repair

Oven not heating, burners not lighting, or temperature off? We repair gas and electric ovens, ranges, cooktops and wall ovens from all major brands.

heading: Quick answers, no jargon.
html:
FAQ

Quick answers,
no jargon.

Something not listed here? Send a message and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

Yes. For urgent failures — like a refrigerator or freezer that has stopped cooling — we offer same-day emergency service across the Tri-Cities. Call us at (509) 300-4042 and we'll dispatch a technician as quickly as possible.

Every repair starts with a diagnostic visit that covers the technician's assessment. Before any work begins we give you a clear, upfront repair price — you approve the cost first. No hidden fees, no surprises.

We service all major brands including Bosch, GE, LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, KitchenAid, Maytag, Frigidaire, Amana, Electrolux, Kenmore, Jenn-Air, Sub-Zero, Viking and more — plus older models other companies turn away.

We serve Richland, Pasco, Kennewick, West Richland, Burbank, Riverview and the surrounding Tri-Cities area — with no rural surcharges or hidden travel fees.

Yes. We work with homeowners, landlords and small businesses — including restaurants, hotels and retail operations that need commercial refrigeration, kitchen equipment and laundry machines repaired fast.
